text:
anya (AE): Heads-up: TeleHealthX wants a POC econ for dedicated GPUs. Asking 16 A100-equiv commit, 12mo, but needs big burst headroom for appointment spikes. Wants aggressive discount and a 99.9% latency promise during bursts.
anya (AE): They propose 40% off commit, burst to +50% capacity, bill bursts at 1.6x, and bursts allowed up to 2h/day.
sam (SE): Quick tech flag: if bursts use shared on-demand, we can't guarantee 99.9% latency. Cold KV caches + model warm-up will add tail latency. We can mitigate with pre-warm or a tiny reserved micro-pool for high-priority traffic.
sam (SE): Sketch of autoscale config they mean:
```
min_replicas: 16
max_replicas: 24 # +50%
scale_window: 5m
prewarm: true
```
raul (Deal Desk): Commercial view: 40% off on 16 units is above our standard concession. We can propose a structured promo: 30% off for a limited POC, burst multiplier 1.5x, and a hard cap on burst hours (e.g., 150-200 hrs over the promo). Anything below 25% needs Finance sign-off.
clare (Finance): Confirmed: finance won't greenlight >30% on this commit without offsetting terms (capped burst hours, shorter promo, or clause to revert to list pricing for prod). Need ARR estimate and expected monthly GPU-hours.
mike (SRE): Ops note: to approach 99.9% SLA during burst we'd need to either increase committed capacity or maintain a pre-warmed pool that sits idle (costly). Alternative: provide an SLO for baseline traffic and a "best-effort" statement for burst traffic plus documented fallback (lighter model variant).
mike (SRE): Also recommend traffic routing: mark urgent inference requests and route to the pre-warmed micro-pool to protect latency-sensitive paths.
anya (AE): Customer can't increase commit (cash constrained). They like a time-limited promo idea. Request: can we do 3-mo POC promo with better econ so they can validate usage? Need a quick yes/no.
raul (Deal Desk): We can offer: 3-month promo, 16 commit, 30% off base, burst multiplier 1.5x, promo burst cap 180 hrs total (not per month), and explicit language: SLA during promo is best-effort. Production pricing to be renegotiated. This is provisional; requires Finance + Legal signoff.
legal-bot: Note: any deviation from standard SLA or special billing must be captured in an SOW and reviewed by Legal. If customer insists on contractual 99.9% during bursts, Ops must approve and we need insurance re-eval.
clare (Finance): If promo is capped at 3 months and burst hours capped, finance can approve 30% promo. Add clause that usage above burst cap billed at 2.0x list during promo period.
sam (SE): I'll draft a short ops mitigation plan: pre-warmed micro-pool sized at 4 GPUs for priority traffic + a light-model fallback for non-critical paths. Will include warmup script and expected KV-cache warm-up latency numbers.
anya (AE): I’ll present the proposed promo to TeleHealthX: 3mo, 30% off, burst x1.5, 180hr burst cap, best-effort SLA during promo, overage billed at 2.0x. Need final text by EOD Friday.
raul (Deal Desk): Action items: @anya send expected monthly GPU-hours and ARR calc, @sam upload ops mitigation doc, @legal-bot queue SOW review, @clare sign off on final numbers. I'll prepare a draft ratecard line and SOW snippet once finance confirms.
anya (AE): Uploading usage spreadsheet and security questionnaire now. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
sam (SE): Putting ops doc in the shared folder; includes a short curl example to verify warm endpoints and a small pre-warm playbook.
raul (Deal Desk): Thanks all — will follow up after finance/legal confirm.
